Planning ref: `main` at `2161b4711d2e952201cb958399614a57cb518f30`. The integration-branch mismatch line reads `unknown`, not `true`, so this is not blocked.

## Automation (§20.E)

- **New scripts:** none. This extends `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` in `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh` and `_mt_merge_lease_tick` / `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` in `scripts/review_merge_train.sh`.
- **Entry points:** unchanged.
  - The step "Release merge-queued PRs (merge train backstop)" in `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` (scheduled poll, `review_merge_train.sh release` at about line 332).
  - The step "Release merge-queued PRs (merge train)" in `.github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml` (runs on every PR close).
- **Supervisor:** none.
- **DB work:** none.
- **`docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`:** no entry, because no script is added.

## Functions or modules to implement

**1. `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh`, two new helpers placed just before `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` (about line 3161).**

- `_merge_lease_hold_labels` prints the configured hold labels, one per line.
  - It reads `"${MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_LABELS-ai:needs-human,ai:security-pass-failed,ai:review-blocked,ai:scope-blocked}"`. The `-` expansion (not `:-`) is the pattern `MERGE_LEASE_PRIORITY_HEAD_PREFIXES` uses at about line 3068: unset gives the default, and empty turns the test off.
  - `none` or `off` (case-insensitive, after trimming) also turns it off and prints nothing.
  - It splits on commas, trims whitespace and drops empty entries.
  - It drops any entry equal to `${MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL:-ai:merge-lease-wait}`, so a misconfiguration can never make every waiter ineligible.
  - It makes no API call.
- `_merge_lease_has_hold_label <labels_nl>` returns 0 when any line of `<labels_nl>` (newline-separated label names) exactly matches a configured hold label.
  - Matching is case-insensitive, because GitHub label names are case-insensitive. It uses fixed-string, whole-line `grep -Fxi -f`, with no regex and no eval.
  - It returns 1 when the list is empty or the test is off.
  - It never prints or logs label names.

**2. `_merge_lease_pr_eligible`: add an optional 8th positional argument `[<labels_nl>]`.**

- The signature comment becomes `_merge_lease_pr_eligible <pr> <head_sha> <title> <draft> [<base>] [<trusted_login>] [<hold_since_epoch>] [<labels_nl>]`.
- New local: `elig_labels="${8:-}"`.
- The new check goes right after the `[skip ai]` check and before the login, head and PR validation, keeping the cheapest-first order with no API read:
  - `if [ -n "${elig_labels}" ] && _merge_lease_has_hold_label "${elig_labels}"; then MERGE_LEASE_INELIGIBLE_REASON="hold_label"; return 1; fi`
- Add `hold_label` to the reason list in the doc comments at about lines 3161-3175 and in the Phase 2 header block at about lines 2445-2457. Document `MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_LABELS` there too.

**3. `scripts/review_merge_train.sh` `_mt_merge_lease_tick`: pass the labels from the listing at both call sites.**

- **Revoke path** (about line 1864): compute `tick_holder_labels` from `tick_holder_row` and pass it as the 8th argument after `"${tick_since}"`.
  - The existing `tick_reason="revoked_${MERGE_LEASE_INELIGIBLE_REASON:-no_head_gate}"` then yields `revoked_hold_label`.
  - The existing block (`tick_p2 = 1` and reason is not `holder_closed`) already adds the `skip=<pr>:<head>` entry, so no extra code is needed.
- **Grant path** (about line 1959): compute `tick_first_labels` from `tick_first_row`. Pass `""` as the 7th argument (the waiter semantics are unchanged) and `"${tick_first_labels}"` as the 8th.
  - The existing branch then unlabels the waiter, logs `MERGE_LEASE pr=<n> base=<b> mode=tick outcome=skipped reason=hold_label` with the metric `event=skipped reason=hold_label`, adds it to `tick_excluded`, and moves on to the next waiter.
- Both label values are extracted with jq, reusing the label-shape expression already in this file: `[ (.labels // [])[] | if type == "object" then .name else . end ] | join("\n")`.
- New local names: `tick_holder_labels` and `tick_first_labels`. Neither exists in the function today; confirm before adding them to the `local` declarations.

**4. `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi`: same change at its two call sites.**

- Revoke at about line 2092: new local `tm_holder_labels`, taken from `tm_listed_row`.
- Grant at about line 2178: new local `tm_first_labels`, taken from `tm_first_row`. Pass `""` as the 7th argument.

**5. Doc comments in `scripts/review_merge_train.sh`.**

- The tick header (about lines 1711-1745) gains `revoked_hold_label` in the revocation list and `hold_label` in the grant-time list.
- The API-budget paragraph says a hold label costs no read, like draft and `[skip ai]`.

**6. No change to `_mt_list_open_prs`.** It already emits `labels: [.labels[].name]` (line 345). The issue asked to add `labels` "if it isn't there yet", and it is there.

## Data structures affected

- The lease record format is unchanged. A hold-label revocation writes the same `skip=<pr>:<head>` line as the other `revoked_*` releases.
- New value `hold_label` for `MERGE_LEASE_INELIGIBLE_REASON`.
- New env var `MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_LABELS`.
  - Default: `ai:needs-human,ai:security-pass-failed,ai:review-blocked,ai:scope-blocked`.
  - Empty, `none` or `off` turns the test off.

## API or interface changes

- `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` gains an optional 8th argument. Existing callers with 4-7 arguments behave exactly as today.
- The two script versions can be mixed safely:
  - An older staged library ignores the 8th argument (no hold test, same as today).
  - An older train script never passes it (no hold test).
- New log tokens, with every existing token, key and function name kept:
  - `MERGE_LEASE ... mode=tick outcome=skipped reason=hold_label`
  - `MERGE_LEASE ... mode=tick outcome=released reason=revoked_hold_label held_s=<s|-> merged=false`
  - `MERGE_LEASE_METRIC event=skipped|released` with the same reasons.
- Workflow env, in the release step of each workflow, next to `MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES`:
  `MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_LABELS: ${{ vars.MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_LABELS || 'ai:needs-human,ai:security-pass-failed,ai:review-blocked,ai:scope-blocked' }}`
  - `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`: only line 298, in the step "Release merge-queued PRs (merge train backstop)".
  - `.github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml`: line 426.
  - The other three poll steps (about lines 1587, 1834 and 1994) and `review_autofix.yml` run only the update-mode gate, which never calls `_merge_lease_pr_eligible`. They do not get this line.
  - Because of the `||` fallback, an empty repository variable gives the default. To turn the test off, operators set `none`; README says so.
- README: a new row after `MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES` (line 165).
  - Columns: `MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_LABELS` | No | the default list | `orchestrate_poll.yml`, `cancel_on_pr_close.yml` (default also set in `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh`).
  - Description: hold labels make a waiter ineligible at grant time (`reason=hold_label`, unlabelled) and revoke a holder (`reason=revoked_hold_label`, skip entry written). There is no API call. `none` or `off` turns it off. It only applies while `MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED` is on. Adding or removing hold labels is still done by the existing latch-release logic.

## Decisions

### D1 — Add an optional 8th argument to `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` instead of a separate check in the tick
- Chosen: the label test lives inside `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` and is fed by a new optional `<labels_nl>` argument. The tick passes labels from the listing at all four call sites.
- Alternatives considered: a sibling helper the tick calls before eligibility at each of the four sites, each with its own reason handling, logging and `declare -F` guard.
- Why: the existing `revoked_${MERGE_LEASE_INELIGIBLE_REASON}` mapping, the unlabel and skip logging, the skip-list write and the metrics already handle any new reason token. Putting the test in one function keeps the four paths consistent and adds no duplicate branches. Mixing script versions fails open to today's behaviour.

### D2 — The env var defaults in the helper, and empty, `none` or `off` turns it off
- Chosen: `${MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_LABELS-<default>}` in `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh`, the same pattern as `MERGE_LEASE_PRIORITY_HEAD_PREFIXES`.
- Alternatives considered: `:-` expansion, where empty would mean the default; or a default only in the workflow YAML.
- Why: the issue says empty or `none` turns the test off. §8 requires the default in the helper, because the helpers are staged from a git ref. Accepting `off` matches the sibling Phase 3 switch.

### D3 — Hold-label skips count toward the 10-candidate cap
- Chosen: no change to the `tick_max_candidates` / `tm_max_candidates` accounting.
- Alternatives considered: not counting skips that cost no API read (hold label, draft, `[skip ai]`).
